q: 最自然的第一版搜索框架是什么？

options: 按字符做 BFS
对每个单词做 include/skip 回溯
把单词排序后贪心全选最长
动态规划枚举所有 26 位 mask 状态
why: 每个单词都是二叉决策，且做出选择后要递归、撤销、再试另一支，这是回溯的典型形状。
why_en: Each word creates an include-or-skip branch, so recursive backtracking matches the decision structure directly.
whenOtherWins: 如果输入已经满足区间贪心或有可证明的最优子结构，贪心或 DP 才更合适；这里冲突组合没有这种简单性质。

q: 在朴素 include/skip 回溯中，哪些说法正确？（多选）
q_en: In plain include/skip backtracking, which statements are correct?
options: skip 分支永远合法
include 分支必须先确认当前单词字符与 used 不相交
include 后必须在返回前撤销 current 和 used 的修改
到叶子节点时不需要更新 best
why: 跳过单词不会破坏合法性；选择单词必须无冲突，并且所有就地修改都要对称撤销，叶子或改进点都要维护 best。
why_en: Skip is always legal, include requires disjoint characters, and every mutation must be undone after the recursive call.
optionExplanations: 对：跳过不修改任何状态，不可能违反约束。
对：字符集合有交集时 include 非法，必须先判断。
对：current/used 是共享可变状态，退出前必须复原对称。
错：叶子或任何改进点都要检查并更新 best，否则丢最优解。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: skipping mutates nothing, so it can never break legality.
Correct: overlapping characters make the include illegal, so check first.
Correct: current and used are shared mutable state and must be restored.
Wrong: every leaf or improvement must update best or the optimum is lost.
options_en: The skip branch is always legal.
The include branch must first confirm the word's characters are disjoint from used.
After including, current and used must be restored before returning.
There is no need to update best at a leaf node.

对：两个集合没有交集，用 isdisjoint 一次调用直接表达。
错：长度比较和字符冲突无关，无法判断是否合法。
错：`word not in used` 是判断整词是否为成员，语义完全不同。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong: the subset direction is backwards and misses the disjoint check.
Correct: isdisjoint directly expresses zero character overlap.
Wrong: comparing lengths says nothing about character conflicts.
Wrong: `word not in used` checks whole-word membership, not character overlap.
options_en: Check whether word's character set is a subset of used.
Check whether used and word's character set are disjoint.
Check whether the word is longer than the used set.
Check whether word as a whole is a key in used.

q: 回溯 include 分支中忘记 `current.pop()` 或忘记从 `used` 移除刚加入字符，最直接的后果是什么？
q_en: What happens if the include branch forgets current.pop() or removing new chars from used?
options: 只会影响运行时间，最终答案仍然正确
兄弟分支继承脏状态，答案可能出错
递归深度会自动变浅，栈开销随之下降
Python 会在函数返回时自动回滚局部修改
why: 回溯依赖「进入分支前后状态一致」；撤销不完整会污染兄弟分支，让后续合法选择被误判成冲突。
why_en: If mutations are not undone, sibling branches inherit stale state and the search can reject legal combinations or return a wrong result.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  Parent[used is ab] --> Include[add cd]
  Include --> Return[return without undo]
  Return --> Sibling[sibling sees abcd]
  Sibling --> Wrong[legal word pruned]
optionExplanations: 错：脏状态会让别的分支误判冲突，答案本身会错，不只是变慢。
对：没撤销的字符残留在 used 里，后续分支会误判成冲突。
错：状态没清理和递归深度无关，深度由 i 决定。
错：`used`/`current` 是可变对象，Python 不会自动帮你撤销。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong: stale state corrupts correctness, not just speed.
Correct: leftover characters in used make sibling branches see false conflicts.
Wrong: recursion depth is driven by index i, unrelated to cleanup.
Wrong: used and current are mutable objects; Python never auto-restores them.
options_en: It only affects running time; the final answer is still correct.
Sibling branches inherit stale state and the answer can come out wrong.
Recursion depth automatically becomes shallower, so stack usage drops.
Python rolls back local mutations automatically when the function returns.

scenario_en: The naive backtracking shares one current list and one used set, and each level runs several sibling branches back to back.

q_en: Put the plain backtracking decision chain in the right order.
steps: 到达叶子或发现更大 used 时更新 best
对当前单词先尝试 skip 分支
若字符不冲突，加入当前单词并递归 include 分支
返回 include 分支后撤销加入的单词和字符
递归状态从第 i 个单词和当前 used 集合开始
why: 朴素搜索围绕同一状态展开两个分支，任何 include 的状态修改都要在回到父帧前恢复。
why_en: Plain backtracking branches from the current state, tries skip and legal include paths, restores mutations, and updates the best solution at terminal or improved states.

q: 朴素 include/skip 回溯的最坏时间复杂度最接近哪一个？
q_en: What is the closest worst-case time complexity for plain include/skip backtracking?
options: O(n log n)，排序主导
O(26^2)，与 n 无关
O(n^3)，三重循环量级
why: n 个单词各有选或不选两种分支，最坏有 2^n 个组合；每帧还要做与单词长度相关的集合检查或更新。
why_en: The worst case has two branches per word, producing 2^n combinations with per-frame work proportional to word length.
optionExplanations: 错：这是排序级复杂度，回溯树的分支数不是 n log n。
对：n 个二元决策给出 2^n 组合，每帧还有 O(m) 的集合操作。
错：26 是字母表大小的常数，和单词数 n 的搜索树无关。
错：n^3 是多项式，掩盖了每个单词二元分支带来的指数增长。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong: that is sort-level complexity, not a branching search tree.
Correct: n binary decisions give 2^n combinations, each frame doing O(m) set work.
Wrong: 26 is the constant alphabet size, unrelated to the search tree over n words.
Wrong: n cubed is polynomial and hides the exponential branching per word.
scenario: 词表里有 n 个单词，每个单词长度约 m；你要预估朴素 include/skip 回溯在最坏输入下的运行时间量级，判断这套方案能不能扛住较大的 n。
scenario_en: The word list has n words of length about m; you need the worst-case runtime scale for plain include/skip backtracking to judge whether it can handle a larger n.
options_en: O(n log n), dominated by sorting.
O of m times 2 to the n.
O(26 squared), independent of n.
O(n cubed), like a triple loop.

termDefinitions.meaning: 描述算法运行时间随输入规模增长的渐进上界记法，O(2^n) 表示指数级增长。

q: 为什么包含大量二三字母短词的数据集会让朴素回溯变慢？
q_en: Why do many two- or three-letter words make plain backtracking slow?
options: 短词冲突少，合法分支能扎得很深
短字符串同样能转换成 set
短词字符少，通常覆盖不了全部字母
短词长度不会让递归失败返回
why: 冲突本身是朴素回溯唯一的自然剪枝；短词互相冲突少，就会保留大量深层分支。
why_en: Short words collide with few others, so conflict-based pruning leaves many deep legal branches alive.
optionExplanations: 对：冲突是唯一的自然剪枝，短词冲突少，深层分支大量存活。
错：任何长度的字符串都能用 set() 转换，和这无关。
错：短词字符少，远达不到覆盖完整字母表。
错：递归返回由函数结构决定，跟单词长短无关。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: conflict is the only natural pruning, and short words rarely conflict.
Wrong: any string converts to a set() regardless of length.
Wrong: short words have few characters and rarely cover the full alphabet.
Wrong: recursion always returns based on control flow, unrelated to word length.
options_en: Short words rarely conflict, so legal branches can go deep.
Short strings convert into a set just as well as long ones.
Short words have few characters and rarely cover the full alphabet.
Word length has no effect on whether recursion returns.
scenario: 同一份朴素回溯在 250 个 5 字母 Wordle 词上很快，换成几千个二三字母短词就跑不完。

options: branch-and-bound 上界剪枝
把递归改成显式栈的 while 循环，但保持原有分支

Wrong: concatenating words loses which characters belong to which word.
Wrong: the first legal solution is not guaranteed to be the optimal one.

Concatenate all the words into one string and count characters there.

对：上界是最乐观估计，连它都赢不了 best 就没必要往下搜。
错：suffix_union 恰好相反，装的是尚未处理的剩余单词。
错：打平不保证存在别的等好解，只是不值得继续搜。

Correct: even the most optimistic estimate can't beat best, so stop searching.
Wrong: suffix_union holds the remaining unprocessed words, not chosen ones.
Wrong: a tie doesn't guarantee another equally good answer exists.

Because even grabbing every remaining new character still cannot strictly beat best.

错：完整状态 DP 在本题规模下状态数太大，反而更慢。
错：排序只影响 best 变强的速度，完全不涉及正确性证明。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong: pruning plus a cheaper representation took 11.78s down to 858ms, easily passing.
Correct: search less first, then make each remaining search step cheaper.
Wrong: full-state DP has too many states at this scale and would be slower.
Wrong: sorting only affects how fast best improves, not correctness.

scenario_en: On a small state universe search problem like this character-coverage task, you have already added branch-and-bound pruning and a bitmask representation.
options_en: Exponential problems can never be optimized enough to pass real test data.
First prune safely to search less, then switch to a cheaper state representation.
Every backtracking solution should be replaced by a full-state DP enumeration.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先估计一个乐观上界，上界不可能超过当前最优解时就剪掉整棵子树的搜索技术。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Branch-and-bound estimates an optimistic upper bound and prunes an entire subtree once it cannot beat the current best.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把问题拆成重叠子问题、用状态表存已算结果来避免重复计算的算法方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dynamic programming breaks a problem into overlapping subproblems and caches results in a state table.
